== Usage ==
The license value inserted when a contributor picks '''"Official Frontier / Elite Dangerous media"''' from the Licensing dropdown on <code>Special:Upload</code>. Wraps the shared {{tl|Frontier assets notice}} wording plus a note that this is Frontier's own released media, not a contributor's gameplay capture. Use only for media Frontier itself released (press kits, official posts) — an ordinary gameplay screenshot should use {{tl|License-ED screenshot}} or {{tl|Elite Dangerous screenshot}} instead.

The outer notice uses the <code>noexcerpt</code> class so maintenance/editorial
text is excluded from article excerpts and Page Previews.
